title: Ensuring Sufficient Engineering Graduates for Projected Needs in Rail Engineering
what_it_is: Ensuring Sufficient Engineering Graduates for Projected Needs in Rail Engineering

sections.label: Rail engineers and Singapore Rail Academy
sections.summary: By 2020, 1,500 more engineers and technicians are expected to be employed, with the Singapore Rail Academy coordinating efforts to grow railway engineering capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: By 2020, we expect to employ 1,500 more engineers and technicians to build, operate and maintain our expanding rail network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The Singapore Rail Academy, which was established in February this year, will coordinate and drive industry-wide efforts to grow engineering capabilities in the railway sector.

sections.label: Public Transport Skills Framework
sections.summary: Government, industry and unions are working in partnership to develop the Public Transport Skills Framework to facilitate skills development and upgrading.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: To facilitate skills development and upgrading, Government, industry and the unions are working in partnership to develop the Public Transport Skills Framework.

sections.label: New railway engineering courses
sections.summary: Over three years, ITEs, Polytechnics and Universities launched seven railway engineering courses, with first graduates ready in one to two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, ITEs, Polytechnics and Universities launched seven new railway engineering courses, ranging from NITEC to Masters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The first few batches of graduates will be ready to join the industry in the next one to two years.

sections.label: Professional Conversion Programmes for engineers
sections.summary: More Professional Conversion Programmes are being offered for mid-career hires, with 108 placements taken by the two rail operators to date.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: In addition, we are also looking to supplement the pipeline of engineers by offering more Professional Conversion Programmes (PCPs) for potential mid-career hires.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: To date, some 108 PCP placements have been taken by the two rail operators.

sections.label: Building deep expertise sub-industry
sections.summary: Building deep expertise in this area could create a new sub-industry for Singapore, like the NEWater industry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: If we can, along the way, build up deep expertise in this area, I think it could again create a new sub-industry for Singapore the way we created the NEWater industry.
